### SceneFun3D

- 精读：[SceneFun3D](A_executable_world_representation/scenefun3d-2024.md) · 本轮结论：优先阅读
- 分数（技术贡献 / 直接相关性 / 证据）：4 / 5 / 4
- 任务：[功能部件与关节结构理解](task_frontiers.md#task-a-functional-part-articulation-understanding)
- 判断：Official annotations, released evaluator and explicit AP protocol form a reusable supervision/evaluation foundation. Recommend the dataset and affordance task interface, not an unverified robot-execution claim.
- 相对已有工作的增量：Unlike FunArt's predicted articulation graph, this is real-scene functional-element supervision and its evaluator; neither replaces the other.
- 来源核查：[Project page, Abstract and three task definitions](https://scenefun3d.github.io/) — The dataset has 710 scenes, over14.8K interaction annotations and three task definitions.（verified）
- 来源核查：[Functional interactive elements; Language task descriptions; Motion annotations](https://scenefun3d.github.io/documentation/dataset/annotations/) — Official JSON schemas expose point indices, affordance labels, description-to-element links and motion type/direction/origin. Transparent/reflective excluded geometry is explicitly documented.（verified）
- 来源核查：[Task description; Local evaluation; Evaluation metrics](https://scenefun3d.github.io/documentation/benchmarks/task1/) — Faro scan/RGB-D input, vertex-aligned masks and nine classes; AP25/AP50 and averaged AP; validation scripts and official hidden-test submissions.（verified）
- 来源核查：[Evaluation guidelines](https://scenefun3d.github.io/documentation/benchmarks/guidelines/) — Current benchmark uses dataset v0.2.0; test ground truth is hidden and only test submissions count toward official ranking.（verified）
- 来源核查：[Task 3: Motion estimation](https://scenefun3d.github.io/documentation/benchmarks/task3/) — The online motion-estimation documentation currently says Coming soon; the priority recommendation does not assume this track is operational.（verified）
- 复查触发：Revisit when the official task/evaluator changes or a matched successor demonstrates a material advance.

### Infinigen Indoors

- 精读：[Infinigen Indoors](B_interactive_generation_pcg/infinigen-indoors-2024.md) · 本轮结论：优先阅读
- 分数（技术贡献 / 直接相关性 / 证据）：5 / 4 / 4
- 任务：[参数化程序场景与标注生成](task_frontiers.md#task-b-parameterized-procedural-scene-data-generation)
- 判断：Reusable procedural asset+constraint code, controlled solver ablations and downstream annotation tests justify sustained reading. The actual random-sample image supports adequate static scene quality; recommendation excludes uninspected contact/robot execution.
- 相对已有工作的增量：Unlike Holodeck's fixed retrieved asset library, geometry and materials are procedural and editable down to asset parameters; dense annotations and solver controls are the retained value.
- 来源核查：[Sections 3.2/3.4; Sections 4.1/4.3 and Tables 3-4](https://arxiv.org/html/2406.11824) — §3.2/3.4 details constraint DSL and export; §4.1/Table3 ablates solver; §4.3/Table4 validates occlusion-boundary training.（verified）
- 来源核查：[§3.2 constraint API; §3.4 export; §4.1/Table3 and §4.3/Table4](https://arxiv.org/html/2406.11824) — Reusable constraint/annotation/export infrastructure. Solver ablation uses20 scenes/5K steps; occlusion-boundary comparison trains matched U-Nets. These are author-reported controls, not independently reproduced robotics validation.（verified）
- 来源核查：[Getting Started: Hello Room; Papers: Infinigen Indoors](https://github.com/princeton-vl/infinigen) — Official code provides indoors-stable and initial-release entry points and the CVPR2024 citation; latest repository also contains later work, so use the paper's version for reproduction.（verified）
- 复查触发：Revisit when the official task/evaluator changes or a matched successor demonstrates a material advance.

### Demystifying When and Why VLAs Fail in Contact-Rich Tasks and How to Fix Them

- 精读：[Demystifying When and Why VLAs Fail in Contact-Rich Tasks and How to Fix Them](D_vla_world_action_models/fact-contact-rich-vla-2026.md) · 本轮结论：优先阅读
- 分数（技术贡献 / 直接相关性 / 证据）：4 / 4 / 4
- 任务：[力觉与触觉支持的接触丰富操作](task_frontiers.md#task-d-force-tactile-contact-rich-manipulation)
- 判断：已核查官方matched训练与每任务结果，并实际查看Plug/FACT的成功及失败双视角时序。它把接触失败拆为精度/受力并提供无新增数据的噪声调度和force conditioning，直接用于接触任务验证。
- 相对已有工作的增量：相对Agile-WAM的tactile未来latent，此法重在低噪动作学习与force时序调制诊断；本轮没有相同传感器的二者直接比较。平均66%不意味着每任务无退化：Board基线100%对FACT90%。
- 来源核查：[Title; Abstract (method and evaluation paragraphs); submission history / Comments when present](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01402) — Abstract identifies precision and force failure modes; FACT increases low-noise sampling and adds structured force conditioning, reporting 66% versus 41% average success across five tasks and almost 2,500 real-world rollouts.（verified）
- 来源核查：[Approach: Precision / Force; Results per-task table and caption; Rollout Gallery](https://stanford-iprl-lab.github.io/fact/) — All methods use pi0.5 LoRA,100 demonstrations/task,20K steps and40 trials/method/task. FACT's average is66.0 versus40.5 ForceVLA; Board regresses100→90 relative to pi0.5. Thus the paper does not establish no-material-regression succession.（verified）
- 复查触发：扩充相同传感器任务/跨平台复现；保留Board退化与失败案例，不能自动归档通用/无force基线。
- [完整复审记录](../reports/reorganization/2026-10-20/branch-D.json)
